item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 08/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to southern China for the rest of this week and early next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. Under the influence of a replenishment of the northeast monsoon, it will be rather cool over southern China in the middle and the latter parts of next week. A broad band of clouds will cover the northeastern part of the South China Sea midweek next week. Besides, unsettled weather is affecting the seas east of the Philippines.
